description: This Java source file defines an abstract assertion class for testing 'ThingModifyCommand' objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to assert if such commands have specific entities attached or not.

classes.name: AbstractThingModifyCommandAssert
classes.description: An abstract assertion class for 'ThingModifyCommand' objects, providing methods to verify the presence or absence of an associated entity.

methods.name: withEntity
methods.description: Asserts that the command has an entity matching the expectedJsonEntity.

methods.name: withoutEntity
methods.description: Asserts that the command does not have an entity.
